name: Poking Nun
source:
You and your wife have been running a local community's church for ages as head priest and priestess. Your religion is open to accepting deities from other religions, so you see no issue helping out the newly founded Church of Love by sending over your lovely wife to teach them the ropes.

What you don't know is just how sexually depraved this new religion really is... and how they will corrupt your wife from a sexually repressed nun to a perpetually horny sex fiend.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4901390/Poking_Nun/?curator_clanid=42762384]Steam[/url]]
translation:
长久以来，你与妻子一直作为神父和修女共同打理着当地社区的教堂。你们信奉的教派素来包容其他宗教的神明，因此当新兴的“爱之教会”成立时，你毫不犹豫地派自己可爱的妻子前去协助，手把手教他们熟悉教务。

然而你万万没有想到，这个新兴教派在性方面究竟有多么淫乱堕落……更没想到他们竟会将你那性压抑的修女妻子一步步调教腐化，变成一个欲求不满的色情狂。
